title: Kagamine Rin — Dressing Up Is Hard〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Empty SEKAI
Lake

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I finished coloring it...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Now what...?)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (I think I'll go see what the others are doing.)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Kanade hasn't been back to SEKAI since then...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (I hope things worked out for her.)
There you are, Rin.
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Kanade...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank goodness I found you so quickly.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I came over to tell you that we finished doing our shoot.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Did it go well...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. Once Tenma learned more about me, she figured out what she wanted to do...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: And I have you to thank for that. I really appreciate your help, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Don't thank me. All I did was tell you how I felt.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
*Nod*
But that ended up being enormous.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, also.
I brought over the picture like I promised.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Picture? Oh...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Let me know if the picture turns out. I wanna see...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Okay.
I'll bring it by once it's ready.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (She remembered...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Tenma sent it to my phone.
Here's how it turned out...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It's you, but not you, Kanade...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I didn't realize just changing your clothes and hairstyle can make you look like a completely different person.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Me neither. I was also surprised when I looked in the mirror.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Tenma said that she arrived on this based on the songs I compose.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Based on the songs you compose...
I think I sort of understand.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Your songs and the girl in this picture both feel really kind.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I see.
Then, Tenma's succeeded in getting her message across to you.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: How would you capture the others' personalities...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
In N25?
Hmm... Well...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I suppose Ena would wear clothes that are all covered in paint...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That doesn't seem right.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I-I'm not so sure either. This is hard...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Mizuki would probably wear something with lots of ribbons and bows...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Hehe. I agree.
I can see it already.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What about Mafuyu...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hmm... Nothing immediately comes to mind, since I really don't know anything about fashion...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Then, what about me...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I feel like your appearance already captures you, Rin...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But why don't we ask the others sometime? They'll probably be more than happy to give us their ideas.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, we should ask them...
